package rulefixtures

import (
	"strings"
)

// scenario for stable_value_normalization_in_inner_loop: Stable value normalization (ToLower, TrimSpace, etc.) repeated inside inner loops.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: hot_path; severity: info.

type Assignee struct {
	Name string
	Dept string
}

type Task struct {
	Assignee string
	Owner    string
}

func scenario366Positive(tasks []Task, assignees []Assignee) []string {
	var matched []string
	for _, task := range tasks {
		for _, assignee := range assignees {
			if strings.ToLower(task.Owner) == strings.ToLower(assignee.Name) {
				matched = append(matched, task.Assignee)
				break
			}
		}
	}
	return matched
}
